# Convex Provider

Manages resources on the [Convex](https://convex.dev) platform through the [Management API](https://docs.convex.dev/management-api).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    convex = {
      source  = "srs/convex"
      version = "0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

# The token may also be supplied with the CONVEX_ACCESS_TOKEN environment
# variable, and the endpoint with CONVEX_ENDPOINT.
provider "convex" {
  token = var.convex_token
}

variable "convex_token" {
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  description = "Convex team access token, created in the dashboard under team settings."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Convex Management API. Defaults to `https://api.convex.dev/v1`, or the `CONVEX_ENDPOINT` environment variable when set.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token used to authenticate against the Management API. This may be a team access token, a personal access token, or an OAuth token. May also be set with the `CONVEX_ACCESS_TOKEN` environment variable.
